messages:
maria (Partnerships): Quick review needed — Hyperion Systems co-marketing bundle. Attached: storyboard (Figma), logo lockup pack (SVG/PNG), draft customer quote. Main asks: 1) legal OK on partner tagline usage "AI-First Compute Fabric"; 2) confirm clearspace + alt text for marketplace tile; 3) final hero frame for the solution brief. Links: figma.com/file/hyperion-storyboard, drive.redwood/hyperion-logos.zip

sam (Design): looked at the Figma — thanks. Notes: their primary logo is a 1:1 mark + wordmark, we should include a stacked lockup for narrow tiles. Pushed updates to figma: added dark-bg variant and a 40px clearspace baseline. Also exported optimized SVGs and 2x PNGs for marketplace. Quick snippet for the marketplace CSS to avoid bleeding: 
```
.tile-hero img { object-fit: contain; padding: 12px; background: #0F1724; }
```

lee (Legal): flagged: the phrase "AI-First Compute Fabric" is a tagline — need written approval from Hyperion marketing for use in co-branded assets and press. Also their quote mentions a customer name (Acme) — we need a signed quote release or anonymize. I'll draft an email template to request clearance.

ana (Marketing): (typo: ana) For marketplace copy, shorter CTA works better. Suggest: "Try Redwood + Hyperion — Fast inference, lower TCO." We should localize CTA variants for EU/JP markets. Also confirm whether Hyperion wants their product SKU shown on the tile (they sometimes prefer generic hardware callouts).

jordan (PM): FYI — engineering asked we not reference model latency numbers in the solution brief (numbers vary by region). Recommend we say "industry-leading inference latency" instead of "<12ms p99". Also need the hero screenshot with console overlays removed for customer privacy. Can design produce a sanitized version?

sam (Design): yes, can do a sanitized hero. Will replace live customer names and remove console breadcrumbs. Updated figma frame: "Hero_Sanitized_v2". Also created an alt text checklist: ["Product dashboard: Redwood + Hyperion integration", "Call to action: Try the integration"] — please confirm.

lee (Legal): agreed on checklist. I'll add the required attribution line in copy: "Hyperion Systems is a registered trademark of Hyperion Systems, used with permission." Also request that we add a one-sentence partner approval note to the asset package.

maria (Partnerships): Good. Action items summary: sam — finalize hero + export SVG/PNG variants (due EOD PST). lee — send partner clearance email and chase quote release. ana — finalize marketplace CTA + 2 localized variants. jordan — confirm product wording (no latency numbers). I'll follow up with Hyperion for tagline approval and share draft email in channel. If anyone wants to batch comments, react with :eyes:.

brand-bot: Assets uploaded to /partners/hyperion/2026-03-22/ (logos_v3.svg, hero_sanitized_v2.png, marketplace_tile_3x.png). Reminder: partner approval SLA = 5 business days.

maria (Partnerships): thanks all — looping in Hyperion contacts tomorrow morning. If Hyperion pushes back on the stacked lockup, we'll fall back to centered lockup + 16px clearspace.

sam (Design): noted. small ask: can marketing confirm which alt text string to use for the EU tile? Two-word limit preferred for accessibility team.

ana (Marketing): pick: "Redwood + Hyperion integration" — I'll ship that.

lee (Legal): once Hyperion signs off on tagline and quote, we can mark assets as approved-for-publish.

maria (Partnerships): thread closed for now — will reopen if Hyperion requests changes.
